title: Initialize active feature planning ledger
decision: Use `pldg-20260622-001-fff` as the active v2 Bootstrap Planning Ledger for the exact placeholder feature token `<fff>`. The ledger is source/planning memory only; canonical Plans and generated governance/build artifacts remain untouched until explicit compile or governance-seal permission is given.

title: Scope fff ledger as search capability evaluation
decision: Treat `<fff>` as a conversational research/design ledger for evaluating dmtrKovalenko/fff, OpenCode's fff usage, and Cursor-style fast regex search to decide whether Puppet Master should add fff-inspired search capability. This is not compile permission and does not authorize canonical Plans edits.

title: Cursor-style regex acceleration is already planned as Instant Grep
decision: Cursor's fast indexed regex-search approach is already substantially documented in Puppet Master as Instant Grep / SparseNgramIndex. The existing canon covers owner split, sparse n-gram query/build model, deterministic candidate reduction, raw ripgrep verification, fallback causes, dirty-layer freshness, storage layout, GUI status/settings, and analytics disclosure. The likely fff gap is fuzzy/frecency file discovery and agent/UI ranking, not raw regex-grep acceleration.

title: Choose native PM-owned fff-inspired discovery
decision: Jared selected `Let’s do native`. The product direction is native PM-owned fff-inspired file discovery, not a direct permanent fff dependency. fff and OpenCode implementation details may be used as reference/evidence, and the temporary cloned repositories must be deleted after inspection.

title: Use one shared substrate for agent tools and GUI surfaces
decision: Native fff-inspired file discovery should be `one shared substrate for both agent tools and GUI surfaces from day one`. Agent/tool consumers and GUI consumers should share the same indexing, freshness, ranking, fallback, diagnostics, and policy substrate while exposing consumer-appropriate APIs.

title: Require conformance contract for agent-bearing discovery consumers
decision: The shared native discovery substrate needs a conformance contract, not just a feature declaration. Every agent-bearing surface must prove it can call the substrate, receive ranked/fresh/fallback-aware results, and respect the same FileSafe, permissions, ignore, freshness, fallback, and policy envelope.

title: Use shared discovery as ambient default agent repo orientation
decision: Agents should use the shared native fff-inspired discovery substrate when working on ordinary tasks, not only when the user explicitly asks to search. A bug-fix request that requires locating the relevant section of code is the first acceptance workflow: the agent uses the shared substrate to discover likely code areas, then follows up with reading and exact verification. This is intentionally stronger than OpenCode current HEAD, where fff is primarily a FileSystem/Search and file-discovery surface integration while model-facing grep/glob tools still use ripgrep directly.

title: Make native discovery implementation-ready in ledger-only form
decision: Proceed with a ledger-only implementation-ready tightening pass. A later compile should frame native PM-owned fff-inspired discovery as a shared DiscoveryService substrate with precise request/result/provenance shapes, ambient agent invocation policy, consumer conformance requirements, FileSafe/permissions/ignore/fallback guardrails, lifecycle/freshness behavior, ranking signals, exact verification handoff, validation scenarios, non-goals, and owner hints. This does not authorize canonical Plans edits, Plans/.plan_index, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, Spec_Lock, shards, evidence, plan_graph, or auto_decisions.

title: Show discovery activity inside Assistant Chat threads
decision: GUI discovery must show what it is doing in Assistant Chat threads. Assistant Chat should surface discovery activity, index warmup/freshness, fallback/degraded paths, policy-denied or hidden-by-policy outcomes, candidate selection, and exact verification handoff as visible thread activity rather than hiding those details only in logs or post-run receipts.

title: Provide GUI setting to hide routine Assistant Chat discovery activity
decision: Assistant Chat discovery activity is visible by default, but the GUI must provide a setting to turn off routine inline discovery activity in Assistant Chat threads. Turning it off suppresses thread noise from normal discovery progress while preserving permission prompts, denied or hidden-by-policy safety messages, durable receipts, final summaries when relevant, and auditability.

title: Accept gap-resolution defaults and require SSH discovery
decision: Jared accepted the four proposed gap-resolution defaults and added that discovery must work over SSH too. MVP scope is path/context discovery with exact content handoff; local worktrees get full-fidelity discovery; remote/cache-backed and SSH-backed project roots must be supported with explicit freshness/fallback disclosure; frecency is on-device, user-scoped, project/worktree-local with GUI reset/disable and sanitized agent use; and the shared substrate is `DiscoveryService` with agent-facing `discover_paths` and discovery-specific receipts/events. SSH must not silently fall back to unrelated local paths or hide stale/cache-backed behavior.

title: Materialize doc-impact and consumer-conformance matrices before compile
decision: The pre-compile matrix pass is complete in ledger-only form. state/doc_impact_matrix.json maps accepted discovery intent to future owner docs, supporting docs, consumer docs, compile obligations, backlinks, and do-not-touch constraints. state/consumer_conformance_matrix.json gives exact conformance rows for all currently identified agent and GUI consumers, including local, remote/cache, and SSH-backed discovery behavior. These matrices do not authorize canonical Plans edits; they make a later explicit compile safer and less guessy.

title: Treat remaining post-matrix gaps as non-blocking compile obligations
decision: After the post-matrix gap review, there are no remaining blocking product, owner-routing, GUI-classification, or consumer-conformance questions before an explicit compile request. The remaining precision items should be carried into compile or early implementation: exact schema/event values, performance/resource budgets, deterministic ranking/tie-breaker/tuning behavior, SSH implementation topology that preserves remote identity/no-local-fallback semantics, and Assistant Chat discovery-visibility setting placement/naming. This does not authorize canonical Plans edits.

title: Resolve discovery precision obligations in ledger-source contract
decision: Jared asked to address the remaining precision issues. The ledger now accepts state/precision_contract.json as source-lineage for exact discovery schema/enum values, performance/resource budgets, deterministic ranking weights and tie-breakers, SSH manifest-adapter MVP topology, and Assistant Chat discovery visibility setting placement/copy. The compile queue remains empty and this does not authorize canonical Plans edits, PlanUnit indexes, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, Spec_Lock, shards, evidence, plan_graph, or auto_decisions.

title: Accept second-order implementation defaults as a batch
decision: Jared accepted the seven recommended second-order implementation defaults with `ok sounds good`. The implementation-ready ledger source now includes rollout/kill switch behavior, canonical path identity and display_path normalization, index/cache schema versioning and rebuild policy, shared scheduler/backpressure semantics, SSH auth/error UX and remote host authority alignment, frecency/history reset versus durable receipt retention, and migration of existing GUI fuzzy/file-search routes through DiscoveryService without duplicate ranking or command rename churn. This does not authorize canonical Plans edits, PlanUnit indexes, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, Spec_Lock, shards, evidence, plan_graph, or auto_decisions.

decision: Jared requested one last deeper audit with multiple subagents and another sweep.
